blocks.html: As part of the measures to minimize health risks, all major tollways shifted to cashless payments. And to cope with the increased number of motorists wanting to avail of free Autosweep RFID stickers, Robinsons Malls are offering again free Autosweep RFID installation for your vehicles in a safe and convenient location!

For those traveling via Skyway/NAIA Expressway, South Luzon Expressway (SLEX), Tarlac-Pangasinan-La Union Expressway (TPLEX), and Southern Tagalog Arterial Road (STAR) Tollways – you can get your free RFID sticker tag by heading to the Autosweep booths and kiosks from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM at the following Robinsons Malls until January 31: January 22 at Robinsons Galleria, lower ground floor in front of Abensons and Robinsons Place Manila, Level 6 Parking Area; January 23 at Galleria South, Level 3 near mall parking entrance and Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Level 1 near fountain area.
Simply pay the initial load of Php200 and you’re good to travel safe and hassle free!

For more information, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
